symptom: ONNX export succeeds but inference fails
likely_cause: Missing companion .onnx.data file for large model
fix: Use rglob to collect all companion files

likely_cause: Opset incompatibility; unsupported op in onnxruntime
diagnostic: Compare opset_version to onnxruntime supported opset
fix: Downgrade to supported opset; check op compatibility table

likely_cause: MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI wrong; proxy dropping Host header
fix: Set MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI explicitly; fix proxy Host header forwarding

likely_cause: URI format wrong; experiment/run ID mismatch
fix: Use exact model name; check models:/ URI format

likely_cause: @production alias not updated; cached local file used
config.pbtxt dims don't match model output
diagnostic: Triton server logs; check config.pbtxt output dims
fix: Update dims in config.pbtxt; restart Triton

likely_cause: Version directory missing; wrong backend name
fix: Create version/1/ directory; check backend name in config.pbtxt

likely_cause: Batch too large; model loaded multiple times
Non-root user missing permissions; wrong CMD
fix: Check file permissions; verify entrypoint CMD is correct

likely_cause: Larger model; different batch handling; CPU fallback
fix: Profile inference path; check GPU vs CPU mode; TensorRT optimize

symptom: Production alias changed but service still runs the old model
likely_cause: Alias mutation changed registry metadata but no runtime refresh occurred
diagnostic: Compare registry target with the model version or artifact digest reported by the running service
fix: Trigger the defined rollout or atomic reload; smoke the real serving path; verify runtime identity

symptom: Promotion automation deploys the wrong version
likely_cause: Events were duplicated stale or keyed only by mutable alias state
diagnostic: Inspect event version ordering deployment history and the runtime-reported artifact digest
fix: Key deployments by immutable version or digest; ignore stale events; serialize promotions; make retries idempotent

symptom: Rollback alias changed but traffic still sees the failed model
likely_cause: Rollback updated only the registry or caches retained the prior artifact
diagnostic: Compare registry target runtime identity and inference response through the live path
fix: Run the same refresh contract used by promotion; wait for rollout completion; verify identity and smoke inference
